summary: Gray Media, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 7, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors authorized a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share on its common and Class A common stock. The dividend is payable September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 15, 2026. The filing is an ordinary dividend declaration, routine in nature, and does not constitute a special situation such as a capital return, tender offer, or other strategic event. The press release attached provides standard corporate information. No special-situation classification applies.
